explanation: Requested eta at W=2.0 GeV, Q2=3.0 GeV^2 with 2.2 GeV beam is physically impossible for fixed-target ep. Required energy transfer nu = (W^2 - m_p^2 + Q2)/(2 m_p) ≈ 3.26 GeV exceeds beam energy 2.2 GeV (scattered electron energy E' = E - nu would be negative). Preflight FAILs on beam_accessibility. Minimum beam energy needed is >3.26 GeV (practically ~4 GeV for E'>0 and safe angles). Channel eta threshold = 1.486 GeV so W is allowed, but the beam is the blocker. Also note eta build requires cos(theta*) != +/-1.0 (use +/-0.999); input would use rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha), not leading-log approximation); default vcut=0.166 GeV^2; table is maid07-PPpi.tbl (actual EtaMAID-2023 content).
